name: Affogato
flavor_notes: A simple yet indulgent dessert featuring rich espresso poured over creamy vanilla or chocolate ice cream, often topped with whipped cream.
barista_note: Pour espresso directly over ice to preserve the temperature boundary and prevent watery dilution.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

ingredients.item: Ice cream, Vanilla or Chocolate Recommended

steps: Fill your serving glass with ice cubes, then pour in cold milk.
Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour the melted coffee directly over the iced milk.
Finish with a dusting of Whipped cream.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.

ingredients.item: Ice cream, Vanilla or Chocolate Recommended

steps: Scoop 1-2 scoops of ice cream into a glass.
Brew the Nespresso Orafio capsule into a pitcher or directly into the glass.
Pour the hot espresso over the ice cream.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Mount Hagen Organic

ingredients.item: Ice cream, Vanilla or Chocolate Recommended

steps: Fill your serving glass with ice cubes, then pour in cold milk.
Dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso in 2 oz (60 ml) hot water to fully bloom the coffee, then pour directly over the iced milk.
Finish with a dusting of Whipped cream.
